description: 1954 is the Year of the Wood Horse in the Chinese zodiac, from February 3, 1954 to January 23, 1955. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1954 is the Year of the Wood Horse, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 3, 1954 and ended on January 23, 1955, so people born in 1954 before Feb 3 belong to the Water Snake year.

sections.heading: When the 1954 Wood Horse year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1954 Wood Horse year began at Lunar New Year on February 3, 1954 and lasted until January 23, 1955, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Feb 3 1954 therefore belongs to the Water Snake year that started in 1953, while someone born in early 1955, up to Jan 23, is still a Wood Horse. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Wood Horse combination also falls in 2014, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1954 fell on a Wednesday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Wood Horse personality
paragraphs: Friendly, imaginative and progressive, the Wood Horse enjoys freedom most when friends come along for the ride. Wood keeps the Horse's Fire supplied, so tradition sees boundless energy paired with cooperative ideals. People born in this year tend to love new ideas and teamwork. Flitting between enthusiasms is their typical pitfall; choosing a destination first helps. Their optimism often carries a group further than expected.

Wood is the element of spring and of things that grow, so a Wood year is traditionally said to lend any animal a generous, expansive streak. Classical descriptions link it with kindness, idealism and a talent for cooperation: Wood people are often pictured as the ones who start community projects, mentor younger colleagues and believe that most situations can improve with patience and goodwill. The element also carries a strong sense of fairness and a dislike of waste. Its shadow side, according to most readings, is overextension. Like a plant reaching in every direction, a Wood-year person may take on too much, trust too readily or struggle to say no when a cause seems worthwhile.

sections.heading: 1954 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits reduce to 1, the number of beginnings, initiative and independence, so numerologists describe a 1 year as one that rewards starting things. The digits of 1954 add up to 19, which reduces to 1. In the twelve-year cycle the Horse is the seventh animal, earthly branch Wu, with Fire as its fixed element and Yang polarity. The year element is Wood, and in the five-element cycles wood generates Fire. The year before was the Water Snake and the year after is the Wood Goat.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Jia-Wu: Jia is the Wood heavenly stem and Wu is the Horse's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yang stems only ever meet yang animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1954?
faq.answer: 1954 is the Year of the Wood Horse. It started on February 3, 1954 and ended on January 23, 1955.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1954?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 3. Born before February 3, 1954, you are a Water Snake; born on or after it, you are a Wood Horse.

faq.question: What element is 1954 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Wood, a Yang year. The Horse's own fixed element is Fire; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1954?
faq.answer: Jia-Wu. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Wood Horse year?
faq.answer: 2014, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2014.
